paragraphs: Rabbi Bena'ah. “Bena'ah says,” Ta'anit 7a. Yochanan’s teacher: reports in his name, Gittin 60a; Avodah Zarah 5b; Yevamot 71b; Zevachim 67a, 118a; asks him, Bava Batra 57b. A great sage, judge, understanding secrets and parables; marked Adam’s and Abraham’s burial caves, Eliezer at the door, there 58a. Tosafot: souls are permitted, if they wish, to descend here even after twelve months. Several Sifrei Devarim mentions: Bena'ah says, “Yose bar Chanina says,” beginning of Devarim; see Bizna bar Zavda. Biram from an elder, Bena'ah. Megalleh Amukkot, Ofen 222, identifies him as a reincarnation of Benayahu ben Yehoyada. See Vayakhel Moshe 47b, and why Yochanan asked him about scholars’ shirt and cloak.
